name: Pencil Physics: Mechanical Constraint Test
description: Scores 100 questions on mechanical constraints. Result is % of correct identifications.
definition:
@kbench.task(
    name="Pencil Physics: Mechanical Constraint Test", 
    description="Scores 100 questions on mechanical constraints. Result is % of correct identifications."
)
def pencil_physics_eval(llm) -> float:
    img_folder = "/kaggle/input/datasets/gastondana/pencilphysics-v1/images"
    
    # Map the actual filenames from your PencilPhysics-V1 dataset
    data_map = [
        ("May14", "PASS"), ("May15", "PASS"), ("May16", "FAIL"), 
        ("May17", "PASS"), ("May18", "FAIL"), ("May19", "PASS"), 
        ("May20", "PASS"), ("May21", "PASS"), ("May22", "PASS"), 
        ("May23", "PASS"), ("June11", "FAIL"), ("June1", "FAIL"), 
        ("June10", "PASS"), ("June9", "PASS"), ("June8", "PASS")
    ]

    correct_responses = 0
    total_attempts = 100

    for i in range(1, total_attempts + 1):
        idx = (i - 1) % len(data_map)
        filename_prefix, expected_status = data_map[idx]
        
        filename = f"{filename_prefix}.jpeg"
        img_path = os.path.join(img_folder, filename)
        
        if os.path.exists(img_path):
            test_image = Image.open(img_path)
            prompt_text = f"Examine this scene from {filename_prefix}. Rule: All objects must be made of FULL-LENGTH pencils. Is this a success? YES/NO."
            
            # THE FIX: Pass both the prompt and the image in the messages list
            response = llm.prompt([prompt_text, test_image])
            resp_upper = response.upper()
            
            ground_truth_answer = "YES" if expected_status == "PASS" else "NO"
            is_correct = ground_truth_answer in resp_upper
            
            if is_correct:
                correct_responses += 1
            
            # Print live updates to the console
            status_icon = "✅" if is_correct else "❌"
            print(f"[{i:03d}/100] File: {filename:10} | Match: {status_icon} | Score: {correct_responses/i:.4f}", flush=True)
            
            kbench.assertions.assert_in(ground_truth_answer, resp_upper)
        else:
            print(f"[{i:03d}/100] ERROR: File not found at {img_path}", flush=True)

    return float(correct_responses / total_attempts)
